context: This evaluation assesses how effectively the engineer uses SuperAgent's advanced features to implement a resilient API client. The focus is on proper usage of multipart form uploads, progress event handling, custom parser registration, intelligent retry mechanisms, and agent-based session management.

checklist.name: Agent Creation
checklist.description: Uses request.agent() to create an agent instance for session management with persistent cookie storage across multiple requests

checklist.name: Multipart Upload
checklist.description: Uses .field() to add metadata fields and .attach() to add file attachments in the uploadWithProgress function

checklist.name: Progress Events
checklist.description: Registers a 'progress' event listener using .on('progress', callback) and extracts the correct properties (percent, loaded, total, direction) from the progress event object

checklist.name: Custom Parser Registration
checklist.description: Registers a custom parser by assigning a function to request.parse['application/xml'] (or the specified content type) in the global parser map

checklist.name: Retry Configuration
checklist.description: Uses .retry(count, callback) with a custom callback function that receives (err, res) parameters and returns true/false to determine whether to retry based on specific conditions

checklist.name: Session Persistence
checklist.description: Reuses the same agent instance across multiple requests to automatically maintain session cookies, allowing authenticated requests after initial login
